title: receive_rrep consumes state on error - prevents RREP retry
description: RouteDiscovery<Searching>::receive_rrep takes self by value and returns Result<Replied, LoadngError>. On validation failure (mismatched fields or missing signature), the Searching state is consumed and lost. Callers cannot recover to continue waiting for a valid RREP or retry. Fix: Return (Self, LoadngError) tuple on error to give back state, or restructure API to validate externally before consuming.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed receive_rrep return type from Result<RouteDiscovery<Replied>, LoadngError> to Result<RouteDiscovery<Replied>, (Self, LoadngError)> so callers can recover the Searching state on validation failure and continue waiting for valid RREPs.
